en.headline: Ultraman 60th-anniversary exhibition in Mong Kok ends Sunday
en.dek: The Ultra Heroes Exhibition 2026 at INCUBASE Arena in Chong Hing Square closes on 13 September after a summer run of costumes, props and reconstructed Six Ultra Brothers scenes.
body: The Ultra Heroes Exhibition 2026 at INCUBASE Arena in Mong Kok is scheduled to close on Sunday, 13 September, the organiser INCUBASE Studio has said, ending a summer display marking 60 years of the Japanese Ultraman series.

The show, which opened on 25 July in basement B2 of Chong Hing Square on Nathan Road, includes a Heroes Assemble section that the organiser said was shown overseas for the first time, alongside reconstructed scenes of the Six Ultra Brothers and about 30 leather suits and props used in filming and sent from Japan. Interactive stations include a transformation device, a monster ball pool and a projection drawing wall.

Opening hours are 11am to 10pm daily, with last admission at 8.30pm. Standard tickets are HK$165; concession tickets at HK$132 are offered to full-time students, people aged 60 or above and persons with disabilities, who the organiser said must show proof at the door. Tickets have been sold through INCUTix and Klook.

The organiser said visitors receive a random clear photocard and a commemorative ticket. A theme shop on site has been selling more than 150 items, including Hong Kong-only goods. Anyone planning a visit this week should check the organiser's latest notice for hours and ticket rules before setting out.

zh.headline: 旺角超人英雄展本周日結束
zh.dek: 慶祝超人系列60周年的《超人英雄展2026》在旺角創興廣場INCUBASE Arena展出至9月13日，展出拍攝用皮套、道具及昭和超人六兄弟場景。
body: 主辦單位INCUBASE Studio表示，《超人英雄展2026》香港站將於9月13日（星期日）結束，為超人系列60周年的暑期展覽畫上句號。
展覽自7月25日起在旺角彌敦道創興廣場地庫B2舉行。主辦單位指，核心展區「英雄大集合」屬海外首度展出，另設昭和超人六兄弟場景，以及約30套由日本運來、曾用於拍攝的皮套與道具。場內亦有變身裝置、怪獸波波池及互動繪畫投射牆。
開放時間為每日上午11時至晚上10時，晚上8時30分後停止入場。展期單人票165元；全日制學生、60歲或以上人士及傷健人士優惠票132元，主辦單位要求入場出示證明。門票經INCUTix及Klook發售。
主辦單位表示，入場人士可獲隨機限定透卡及紀念門票。場內主題店售賣逾150款商品，包括香港限定貨品。本周前往的市民應先查看主辦單位最新公布的開放及票務安排。
